title: Config Sync store lock
description: store.lock.json at the store root: provenance and freshness of the store's CONTENT. Written by Config Sync, never by hand — this schema documents the format for other tools and for future versions of the plugin itself. UNKNOWN PROPERTIES ARE VALID EVERYWHERE AND MUST BE PRESERVED: a lock travels between devices that may run different plugin versions, and a reader that drops what it does not recognise destroys a newer writer's bookkeeping (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, invariant II).

version.description: The lock's own format version. Absent = 1 (the shape before per-item freshness). The plugin writes 2. A version HIGHER than the reader understands is refused, not normalised: capture, pull and push all decline rather than overwrite bookkeeping they cannot read. A refusal gate must read this field off the raw text, before parsing — a future version that restructures an entry makes a v1-shaped parse throw, and a gate downstream of that parse never runs.

syncedWatermark.description: The lineage watermark: how far this store has followed the remote it pulls from. Only a pull moves it, and it takes the remote's lineage rather than the remote's bare watermark. Absent = a v1 lock, whose capturedAt answers for it. Kept separate from capturedAt because one field cannot mean both "when this store was captured" and "how far it has followed someone else".

capturedAt.description: When this store's content was last captured. Since v2 it is DERIVED — max(groups[*].capturedAt) — and a pull never rewrites it, so it always describes this store's own content.

groups.description: One entry per group present in the store, keyed by group name.

entry.description: At least one of sourcePluginVersion / sourceAppVersion is required — a v1 reader rejects an entry with neither, which is why both stay flat here instead of moving under a nested object.

sourcePluginVersion.description: Version of the plugin this item's settings were captured from (plugin items).

sourceAppVersion.description: Obsidian version this item was captured on (Obsidian/core items).

capturedAt.description: When THIS item was captured. Absent on an entry no v2 build has captured yet — absence is not a difference. It orders two sides once a real difference is found; it is never itself a difference, or two devices holding identical content captured at different moments would look out of sync.

hash.description: Fingerprint of this item's WHOLE store copy — the base file plus its __scopes__ sidecars, or every file under a dir group's store path. The prefix names the algorithm so it can change later without a reader guessing. Absent for an encrypted item: its envelopes carry their own salt and nonce, so two devices holding identical settings hold different bytes, and a fingerprint would report a difference that is not one.

desktopOnly.description: Set only when the plugin's own manifest says it cannot install on mobile — an innate property of the plugin, not a user choice, and only ever written as true (absent means false).

label.description: This device's best-resolved display name for the group. Display only — never a difference when two locks are compared.

memberLabels.description: Element id -> display name, only on the two carrier entries (core-plugins, community-plugins), for on/off-list members that have no lock entry of their own. Display only, like label.
